display_text: Treasure of Crystal Cove Hat Upgrades :* [[Scallawag's Luck|Scallawag's Luck II]] :* [[Enchantable: Crystal Rush]][[Enchantable: Crystal Rush]]: This hat can be enchanted to bestow one of various benefits to nearby kobolds in Crystal Cove. :* [[Enchantable: Adventuring Bonus]][[Enchantable: Adventuring Bonus]]: This hat can be enchanted to bestow one of various benefits useful in general adventuring. Adventuring effects may change the minimum level of this item. :* [[Enchantable: Skilled Seaman]][[Enchantable: Skilled Seaman]]: This hat can be enchanted to grant a bonus to one skill.
